channel.title: Hyperbyte Cloud
channel.description: Notes on HyperbyteDB, InfluxDB v1 compatibility, and time-series engineering.

item.title: From 99M to 1.9M Rows/sec: What Benchmarks Don't Tell You
item.description: A benchmark that drops from 99 million to 1.9 million rows/sec under realistic conditions, and why headline ingest numbers mislead you.

item.title: Scaling chDB Inserts from 5M to 99M Rows/sec
item.description: How we took chDB insert throughput from 5 million to 99 million rows per second: batching, the write path, and where the real bottlenecks were.

item.title: Run InfluxDB v1 on Kubernetes? Swap the Operator, Keep the URLs
item.description: Replace InfluxDB v1 on Kubernetes with HyperbyteDB's operator. Same /write and /query endpoints, same Telegraf and Grafana configs, replication included.

item.title: Telegraf, Grafana, and Alerts on a Database That Doesn't Buckle
item.description: Point Telegraf and Grafana at a new URL and keep the rest of the stack. What transfers unchanged, where InfluxQL differs, and what ships in the binary.

item.title: Why InfluxDB Enterprise Pricing Hits a Wall
item.description: Retention policies, continuous queries, and replication sit behind InfluxDB's paid tier. What that costs, what HA means, and what HyperbyteDB's binary includes.

item.title: IoT Analytics at Scale: InfluxQL Without Downsampling
item.description: Real-time InfluxQL analytics on millions of IoT sensors without downsampling. GROUP BY device_id, rolling averages, and anomaly detection at full resolution.

item.title: High Cardinality Without the Rewrite
item.description: InfluxDB v1 slows to a crawl on high-cardinality tags. HyperbyteDB handles them with columnar ClickHouse storage. Keep your InfluxQL, change one URL.

item.title: Before You Trust Our Numbers, Run This — HyperbyteDB Benchmarks
item.description: Run HyperbyteDB's own Criterion ingestion benchmarks in minutes. What is measured, what the line protocol and columnar numbers mean, and what to record.

item.title: Exporting Historical Time-Series from InfluxDB v1 to HyperbyteDB
item.description: Migration guides cover Telegraf and Grafana, then leave historical data behind. How to export time-series from InfluxDB v1 and load it into HyperbyteDB.

item.title: InfluxDB v1 Compatibility: What Works in HyperbyteDB
item.description: HyperbyteDB speaks InfluxDB v1 line protocol and InfluxQL on the same endpoints. Endpoint coverage, InfluxQL support, known differences, and cutover notes.

item.title: InfluxDB v1 Migration Checklist: Which Clients Need Only a URL
item.description: A client-by-client InfluxDB v1 migration checklist: Telegraf, Grafana, custom apps, Python scripts, and Java services, and which only need a URL change.
